metadata.description: Future-proofing analysis for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML graduates evaluating long-term country prospects
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student planning 20-30 year horizon: study, work, PR, citizenship, family
metadata.criticalNote: Future-proofing scores reflect 2035 and 2045 outlook - aging populations, AI investment, labor shortages, and immigration openness are key drivers

agingPopulationNeed.immigrationDependency: Very High - immigration drives 100% of population growth

demographicTrend.populationGrowth: Immigration-dependent; native birth rate below replacement
demographicTrend.workforceChallenge: Significant - aging boomers retiring en masse 2025-2035

longTermImmigrationNeed.annualImmigrationTarget: 500,000+/year through 2025 (may reduce but structural need remains)
longTermImmigrationNeed.policyStability: Medium - political pressure to reduce but economic need overrides

technologyGrowth.weaknesses: Brain drain to USA remains significant

laborShortageOutlook.benefit: High demand = easier PR, stable jobs, salary growth

risks.housingCrisis: Severe - structural issue unlikely to fully resolve by 2035
risks.politicalShift: Conservative government may reduce immigration temporarily

futureProofing.forecast2035: Strong - aging population forces continued immigration; AI sector mature; housing stress easing slightly but unresolved; salary growth moderate
futureProofing.forecast2045: Very strong for immigrants - Canada will need millions more workers; tech sector dominant; climate refugee pressure may challenge housing further
futureProofing.overallVerdict: Safe long-term bet with high immigration certainty; housing the main challenge
